collection.description: Shown in the status strip. Name the cache, not the site.

base.description: Prefix joined to every relative file path. "audio/" serves short pieces from public/audio/ beside the app (same origin, nothing to configure); an https R2 host for anything over Cloudflare's 25 MiB asset cap. Never a root path like "/audio/": inside Workbench ADIT lives at /adit/.

id.description: WP-C core, WP-K kit, WP-W wavetable.

file.description: What plays. Relative to base, or an absolute https URL. FLAC is half the weight of PCM and every current browser decodes it.

tags.description: Seams: shown on the row and searched. The filter bar is the fixed categories, not these.

master.description: Optional. What the download button pulls instead of file — normally the 32-bit float WAV, since FLAC is integer-only and cannot carry headroom above 0 dBFS.

category.description: Which filter the core sits under: field (recordings), samples (processed clips), strip (SLUICE stems), kit (FATHOM kits), waves (LATHE wavetables). Optional: without it a core is field.
